summary.text: Nick Pachota is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Ryan Neill; there is no incumbent in the race.
Pachota, a firefighter and paramedic, won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary with 34.8 percent of the vote, and his campaign biography says he is the mayor of Venice.

paragraphs.text: Nick Pachota graduated from Cardinal Mooney High School and earned an associate degree from Valencia College in 2007, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working as a firefighter and paramedic.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as a 25-year first responder and small business owner who worked as an EMT, paramedic, firefighter and SWAT medic, and as a co-owner of the Venice Pier Group.
The survey also says he has been an adjunct instructor in Sarasota County Public Schools' emergency medical services education program for over a decade.
Pachota defeated Kelly Ann Walker, Jennifer Winkler and Carlton Nichols in the 2026 Republican primary.

In his survey responses, he named affordability, including lower insurance premiums and property taxes, protecting constitutional freedoms, and public safety and workforce development as key campaign messages.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements from State Rep. James Buchanan, the Florida Police Benevolent Association and Florida Realtors PAC, among others.
